hack.root_cause: Flash loan oracle manipulation via Solidly AMM pool → user position liquidation
hack.description: Deus DAO's freshly launched DEI lending contract lost ~$3M when an attacker flash-loaned from the same pool used as its price oracle, manipulated collateral valuations, and liquidated real users' positions for profit.
